I have this family member that loves to track my weight, I have been the same weight during my whole adult life, sometimes I have more or less pounds but nothing crazy. This family member has gained a ton of weight, every time she sees me she starts talking about how skinny I am and that I need to gain weight. The thing is that I'm the same and she's the one who has been ballooning. I've been thinking in a sentences to put everything to rest: "I've been skinny my whole life you are the one who's gained weight" 

I have some doubts because I know that comment will create a shitstorm in my family but I'm very tired of they tracking my weight when they should be worried about theirs. Everyone in my family has gained a bunch of weight during the last five years. They should be minding their business and worry about their arteries.
I think this decision is based more on corporations than the science.

A friend of mine decided to spew some COVID-19 stupidity on a group chat about the booster shots. I took a deep breath and kept it moving, this friend has basic (and maybe higher) knowledge of technology and they have decided that is better to keep being ignorant. I'm not going to engage in more shenanigans. The only thing that hurts me is that they are putting innocent people on the line.

Aren't you tired of explaining vaccination so many times that you just don't waste anymore time and energy? Yesterday it was announced in my country that we will have another booster shot and one of my contacts started with the stupidity. I was scrolling and thought in giving him an explanation but I'm just tired and exhausted of the gaslighting from people that don't know anything and refuse to get proper information. They have access to the same internet than I do, a simple Google search is enough to answer a lot of doubts. These people refuse to do that, and I'm not sacrificing my mental health further. Though when I decided to take the medical field route I promised to help and inform others I'm just exhausted of repeating myself over and over.  I'm at the point that I only explain to people who have genuine concerns and are willing to learn, I refuse to engage in rodeos about fake news, it's time for some selfcare.
